notes.title: Grandiose systems of IMPROVEMENT AND CUSTOMIZATION OF HEROES
notes.content:
[h1]HERO SHIP IMPROVEMENTS[/h1]
Greetings - a HUGE major update that introduces GRAND ADDITIONS TO HERO SHIP IMPROVEMENTS !
In the manner of MOBA and Rogue-like games:

1. [b][u]Serious improvements every few minutes ![/u][/b]
- Each ship has its own upgrade tree
- And they greatly affect gameplay and presence on the battlefield.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44851655/be07f43d63e7d1ed080b073b5f53b9bc73a9d55c.png[/img]

2. [u][b]System of additional modules[/b][/u]
- install additional functionality
- UNIQUE gameplay-changing features that can fundamentally change the balance of power
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44851655/1a3134e720958f33df13a99b049391babf5c4d09.jpg[/img]

3. And this is in addition to unlocking the levels of the SKILLS within the missions With a global RESEARCH TREE usage as a metagame!


[h1]Rebalancing[/h1]
[u][b]BOSES[/b][/u] - they are dangerous with unique skills and can say their weighty word... be prepared to face them
[u][b]More Mobs, more action ![/b][/u]


[h1]Many improvements[/h1]
[olist]
[*] Only 2 types of resources! (one for improvements, one for general use)
[*] The player always has a weak, but attacking weapon, always active.
[*] More comfortable control of the hero
[i]- moves to a specified point
- removed the penalty from collisions with obstacles (on easy and medium difficulty level) - according to player feedback, it was annoying[/i]
[*] Integrated tutorial (more comfortable and understandable)
[*] Saves !
[*] Information highlight: tooltips on skills and modules, digital indicators (armor, health, shields, etc.)
[*] Many small improvements and bug fixes
[/olist]

[b][u]We are preparing more grandiose changes - follow the project ![/u][/b]
